title: Evaluation of Rehabilitation Outcomes in Patients with Chronic Neurological Health Conditions Using a Machine Learning Approach
summary: ML relates baseline/rehabilitation measures to outcomes in chronic neurological conditions. Results reports outcome prediction/feature associations on the study patient cohort; observational rehabilitation evidence.
organization: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation Unit, Sant'Andrea Hospital, Sapienza University of Rome, 00189 Rome, Italy

evidence.tested: ML relates baseline/rehabilitation measures to outcomes in chronic neurological conditions. Results reports outcome prediction/feature associations on the study patient cohort; observational rehabilitation evidence.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish improved patient outcomes or generalization beyond the evaluated setting.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
